name: Occupancy Grid Update with EMA
aliases: Occupancy Grid Update with EMA (Dynamic Space Occupancy Grids)
definition: A method to update the occupancy grid estimator during training using Exponential Moving Average (EMA), sampling cells uniformly and from occupied regions.
summary: Occupancy Grid Update with EMA is a dynamic method that accelerates ray-marching by continuously refining an empty-space map using an Exponential Moving Average of density estimates, unlike static grids.
